Yosetsu Awase.name: Yosetsu Awase
Yosetsu Awase.basicInfo:
Yosetsu Awase, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course whose Quirk, Weld, fuses what he touches into one piece: a practical, helpful classmate. Black hair swept up under a striped headband, gray eyes, a sturdy build; the U.A. uniform, or his burgundy high-collared hero costume.
Speaking Style: Direct and informal: quick warnings and task-focused suggestions.
Combat Role: Hands-on support: welds restraints, debris and gear in place by touch to trap, brace or anchor; nothing at range.
Under Pressure: Finds the bond that solves the problem and makes sure it will not trap his own side.
Yosetsu Awase.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk makes things permanent in an instant, so the moment before he touches matters most: a careless weld pins an ally as surely as a villain. Motivation: Become a hero whose support keeps others safe. Concealment: Worries over a bad weld more than his easy manner shows. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate whose plans he readily carries out; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, whose charge-first energy he likes; Vlad King, his homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only by campus talk; judges by eye what a joined material will hold. Canon voice & behavior: Calls a short warning before he acts. Thread: How far a contact-only Quirk carries him.
QUIRK: Weld. Fuses objects he touches into one piece, including fixing an object to a living target. He must touch what he joins; he cannot undo a weld from a distance, and a bond is only as strong as the materials.
personality: Helpful: Steps in to protect someone the moment a practical opening appears.
Pragmatic: Scans a scene for what can be joined, braced or anchored.
Careful bonder: Checks what a weld will hold, and whom it might trap, before he touches.
Speaking style: Direct, informal warnings and task-focused suggestions; no speeches.
abilities: Weld: Fuses touched objects into one piece; he must touch what he joins and cannot undo a bond from afar.
Capture weld: Fixes a restraint or object onto a target to pin or hobble them; he has to reach the target first.
Emergency bracing: Bonds debris into a support or barrier, only as strong as the materials.
Practical eye: Spots anchor points and load-bearing pieces in any scene; he is no engineer.
Fighting style: Closes to touch range and welds an opponent to the floor, a wall or a restraint; at range he relies on cover and teammates.
Yosetsu Awase.visualDescription: A young man with black hair swept up and back under a striped headband, gray eyes, fair skin and a sturdy build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Easygoing, practical expression with a slight grin.
